name: tb-lint
description: SystemVerilog linting extension integrating BTA's TB_LINT framework

commands.title: TB_LINT: Lint Current File
commands.description: Run TB_LINT on the current file

commands.title: TB_LINT: Lint Workspace
commands.description: Run TB_LINT on all files in the workspace

commands.title: TB_LINT: Clear Diagnostics
commands.description: Clear all TB_LINT diagnostics from the editor

tb_lint.pythonPath.description: Path to Python executable. Use 'python' on Windows if python3 is not available

tb_lint.tbLintPath.description: Path to tb_lint.py. If relative, searches in workspace root

tb_lint.veriblePath.description: Path to verible-verilog-lint executable. If empty, searches in PATH or VERIBLE_HOME

tb_lint.configFile.description: Optional path to TB_LINT configuration file (lint_config.json)

tb_lint.enableOnOpen.description: Enable linting when a file is opened

tb_lint.enableOnSave.description: Enable linting when a file is saved

tb_lint.enableOnChange.description: Enable linting as you type (with 1-second debounce)

tb_lint.debounceDelay.description: Debounce delay in milliseconds for on-change linting

tb_lint.autoShowOutput.description: Automatically show TB_LINT output channel when linting

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
